title: Krause alpha-smallness, factorization classes and alpha-compactness
statement: In a category with v-small coproducts, IsAlphaSmall U alpha means every map U to a coproduct factors through a subcoproduct with fewer than alpha summands. A class S satisfies G4 if every map from U in S to a coproduct of Y_i factors through a coproduct of Z_i in S with component maps Z_i to Y_i. IsAlphaCompact U alpha means U belongs to a class whose members are alpha-small and which satisfies G4. The canonical class alphaCompactObjects is this maximal class, expressed by the existence of such a witnessing class; it has no chosen data.

source.place: Krause, On Neeman's Well Generated Triangulated Categories (2001), pages 121--122, conditions G3/G4 and the maximal class T^alpha; Localization theory 6.2--6.3.
